components.name: Mail-triage agent
components.responsibility: Polls Gmail, judges each new mail with the model, labels it and runs every Telegram dialogue with the user (alerts, snooze, reply, settings, web-change notices, web lock); its migrate job is the only migrator of the database.
owns: public schema: mail items, alerts, drafts, audit and overview log, conversation state, poll state, web_notice_token (full rights), encrypted Gmail token
Alembic chain and grants for all schemas (public, settings, web_auth), run by its migrate job with the owner role (ADR-0025, ADR-0030)
web_auth: select, insert, update and delete on web_lock; select on four columns of security_event (ADR-0033, ADR-0039)

components.name: Web settings API
components.responsibility: Serves the settings API to the web page: username plus e-mailed one-time-code sign-in, sessions, CSRF, rate limits and versioned reads and writes of the shared settings row.
owns: web_auth sessions, login requests and security events (data; the DDL lives in the mail-triage chain)
co-writer of settings.schedule through the shared contract (ADR-0023, ADR-0025)

components.name: Web app
components.responsibility: Responsive settings page in the browser: sign-in with username and code, and viewing and changing the settings, only through the api's OpenAPI contract.
owns: unsaved form draft in the browser tab

components.name: schedule-policy
components.responsibility: Pure Python rules for the settings contract: the TimePolicy model, whole-row validation, typed-time parsing and the place list for time-zone lookup, used by both mail-triage and the api.
owns: settings validation rules and contract cases

components.name: Design tokens
components.responsibility: Single source of the Pebble design tokens and fonts, generated into CSS for the web app (ADR-0035).
owns: token source and the generated CSS

components.name: Deployment
components.responsibility: Runs the system: Helm charts, environment values, Argo CD objects, Traefik ingress, network policies, sealed-secret references and the local and prod-like stack support files.
owns: Kubernetes manifests, values per environment, ingress and TLS settings

components.name: assistant (unused scaffold)
components.responsibility: Unused scaffold of a Strands chat agent on Bedrock AgentCore, kept as the start of the wanted chat with the agent; it conflicts with ADR-0017 and must be rebuilt for the Anthropic API when that feature is designed.

components.name: chat-gateway (unused scaffold)
components.responsibility: Unused scaffold of a stateless Telegram and WhatsApp webhook relay to an agent, kept as the start of the wanted chat; it conflicts with ADR-0019 and ADR-0037 and must be re-decided when that feature is designed.

components.name: tools (unused scaffold)
components.responsibility: Unused scaffold of an MCP tool server, kept as the start of the wanted chat with the agent; no feature uses it yet.

components.name: PostgreSQL
components.responsibility: The one relational database (ADR-0007), split in schemas with one login role per runtime and least-privilege grants (ADR-0025, ADR-0030).
owns: public: mail-triage state, capped mail content (30 days, ADR-0020), encrypted Gmail refresh token, audit (confidential)
settings: schedule (shared contract) and settings_change (append-only, trigger-written); time zone and quiet hours reveal the user's routine (confidential)
web_auth: sessions, login requests with hashed codes, security events, web_lock (confidential)

components.name: Gmail API
components.responsibility: The user's mailbox: mail-triage lists, labels and (after confirmation) sends mail (ADR-0011).

components.name: Google OAuth 2.0
components.responsibility: One-time consent and token refresh for the Gmail scopes of mail-triage.

components.name: Anthropic API
components.responsibility: Judges each mail (category, urgency, summary) with a JSON-schema result (ADR-0017; accepted risk in ADR-0018).

components.name: Telegram Bot API
components.responsibility: The user's channel for alerts, buttons, dialogues and notices; long polling, no inbound endpoint (ADR-0019; accepted risk in ADR-0018).

components.name: SMTP server
components.responsibility: Delivers the sign-in code mail from a send-only account over STARTTLS (ADR-0036); smtp4dev in local stacks (INT-005), the production server is not decided yet.

components.name: Amazon Bedrock / AgentCore
components.responsibility: Model and runtime provider referenced only by the unused scaffolds; rejected for this project by ADR-0017.

components.name: WhatsApp Cloud API
components.responsibility: Referenced only by the unused chat-gateway scaffold; no ADR chooses it.
